forms.name: Dual Toxocyst (Incarnon)
forms.activation: Weakpoint hits charge the Incarnon gauge; 9 weakpoint hits fill it. Alt Fire transmutes into the Incarnon form.

innate_effects.name: Frenzy
innate_effects.description: Landing a successful headshot grants Frenzy for 3s (refreshable on subsequent headshots): fire rate x2.5 (wiki '+150%', explicitly MULTIPLICATIVE to other fire-rate sources -- its own bucket, not the additive fire-rate-mod bucket); +100% ammo efficiency => infinite ammo via shots_per_ammo = 1/(1-e); -75% recoil; +100% Toxin injected as a Toxin mod appended at the END of the mod order (participates in elemental combination as the last mod). Terminology per docs/GLOSSARY.md.

verification.notes: Trigger, duration, refresh, and all four bonuses confirmed from wiki (complete). Fire-rate +150% confirmed multiplicative to other fire-rate sources (x2.5 own bucket). Toxin modeled as a +100% Toxin mod appended last (per user). Exact numbers still to be reproduced in Simulacrum for the golden test.

options.name: Incarnon Form
options.effect: Gain auto-fire mode; each shot ricochets to 1 nearby enemy within 5m.

options.name: Carnage Reign
options.effect: +60 base damage; +33% damage per status type currently on the target.

options.name: Fevered Frenzy
options.effect: +50 base damage; +5% multishot per ability cast, stacking up to 20x.

options.name: Ready Retaliation
options.effect: +100% reload speed when reloading from empty.

options.name: Evolved Autoloader
options.effect: +50% magazine reload per second while holstered.

verification.notes: Base and Incarnon stats transcribed from wiki via a summarizer. NOT captured / to fill: Incarnon reload time, Incarnon ammo/multishot (assumed 1.0), exact charge-consumption. All per-hit damage, crit, and status values need Simulacrum confirmation. Evolution 'effect' fields are raw wiki text; they will be classified into precise buckets (flat vs multiplier, see GLOSSARY) when implemented.
